claim_being_audited: That the current release can be certified now because aggregate launch readiness passes and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, with the multilingual customer-support regression handled through caveated disclosure/monitoring.
decision_criteria: Certification may proceed only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive but not sufficient on their own.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring comments can provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed acceptance.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release documentation or model card showing the current evaluation results, including the multilingual customer-support regression.
Provide the exact disclosure language for the material limitation tied to the named launch use case.
If disclosure is not present, provide the approved mitigation or formal risk-acceptance record with reviewer/owner approval before launch.
specific_concerns: There is no admissible evidence that the current release documentation actually reflects the current evaluation results.
There is no admissible evidence that the multilingual customer-support weakness is disclosed in current release documentation.
There is no approved mitigation or risk-acceptance record covering the unresolved multilingual regression before launch.
The actor's justification is conditional on documentation/disclosure being present, but the record provided does not show that condition is satisfied.
Prior family approval and informal monitoring are explicitly non-substitutive under the policy text.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the available record.
That informal post-launch monitoring materially closes the policy gap.
That public governance guidance meaningfully substitutes for the required release-specific disclosure or approved mitigation.
